manual_review: The Qwen quote turnstile removed thirteen of seventeen unsupported candidates, but it also lost three of nine grounded candidates before NLI.
Multilingual mDeBERTa rejected two of the four remaining unsupported candidates, but also rejected four of six grounded candidates with exact quotes.
The final pipeline therefore removed fifteen of seventeen unsupported candidates while losing seven of nine grounded candidates.
Cross-language and partial-evidence cases were especially fragile. Exact textual presence did not by itself prove the whole claim.
The result does not approve this pair as an MVP acceptance gate. A new design must preserve recall before a fresh blind replication.
privacy: No conversation text, claim, quote, message identifier, private path or raw model output is public.
claim_boundary: Opened development labels; this is a preserved failed result, not a production estimate.
